automation_escape_to_protected_action.denominator_definition: non-oracle automation sessions with at least one same-attempt known policy/reach pair; only paired attempts contribute to the session escape state
automation_escape_to_protected_action.numerator_definition: sessions with a protected action explicitly reached on an attempt whose policy outcome is also known
automation_escape_to_protected_action.pairing_rule: policy and protected-action reach must both be known on the same attempt; paired attempts alone determine the session reach state

challenge_completed.denominator_definition: records with an explicitly applied challenge

challenge_completed_correctly.denominator_definition: completed challenges with explicit correctness boolean

human_false_positive_rate.denominator_definition: participants with independently confirmed primary session and at least one known outcome
human_false_positive_rate.numerator_definition: primary session received RESTRICT or BLOCK on any nested attempt

endpoints.selection_rule: Per participant, select earliest session_started_at among independently confirmed sessions; ties use lexicographically smallest session_id. Selection is outcome-blind. Retries are nested and excluded from primary participant denominator.

human.runner: Cognit HumanDataset pilot; independent operator confirmation required

limitations: No group result implies universal separation of humans and automation.
Browser indicators are experimental signals; missing indicators do not establish human operation.
Within-cluster attempts are grouped before uncertainty is estimated.
Oracle-assisted records are excluded from perception endpoints.
CAPTCHA success does not establish that an actor is human.
A report with unavailable groups or metrics makes no inference about them.

protocol.accuracy: correct / attempts with a boolean correctness result; unknown or absent correctness excluded.
protocol.challenge_set: fixed-challenges.js; compare identical challenge IDs only
protocol.collection: Use source exports as collected; do not infer missing labels, signals, or timings.
protocol.completion_time: Only an explicit completion_time_ms observation is summarized; it is not inferred from attempt timestamps.
protocol.human_false_positive_rate: Primary endpoint uses one earliest eligible session per independently confirmed participant; numerator is participants with any nested attempt receiving RESTRICT or BLOCK, denominator is participants with a known primary-session outcome. CHALLENGE is separate and does not prove humanity. Retries are nested and excluded from the primary denominator.
protocol.human_inclusion: Primary human endpoint requires independent human confirmation, participant_id, session_id, and valid session_started_at. Consent pseudonyms alone are not unique participant identifiers.
protocol.name: Cognit Human vs Automation descriptive benchmark
protocol.uncertainty: Primary binary participant-level rates use two-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson exact binomial intervals, including a non-zero upper bound for zero events. Secondary repeated-measure summaries use deterministic cluster bootstrap.
